column3: XunitTest.ConcreteClosureTest.EmitsConcreteClosures(name: \"DiscardedAfterMatch\", source: \"let a: i32 = 1\\nlet i: i32 = 0\\nmatch i\\n    0 => Console.writeLine(\\\"zero\\\")\\n    _ => ()\\nfunc [a] () => a\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(a)\\\")\", output: \"zero\\n1\\n\")

XunitTest.ConcreteClosureTest.EmitsConcreteClosures(name: \"DiscardedBlockArms\", source: \"let a: i32 = 1\\nlet i: i32 = 0\\nmatch i\\n    0\\n        func [a] () => a\\n        (func [a] () => a)\\n    _ => ()\\nlet r = match i\\n    0\\n        func [a] () => a\\n        yield 5\\n    _ => 2\\nmatch i\\n    0 => (func [a] () => a)\\n    _ => ()\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(r)\\\")\", output: \"5\\n\")

XunitTest.ConcreteClosureTest.EmitsConcreteClosures(name: \"DiscardedInFunction\", source: \"func f(i: i32, a: i32) -> i32\\n    match i\\n        0 => func [a] () => a\\n        _ => ()\\n    return a\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(f(0, 3))\\\")\", output: \"3\\n\")

XunitTest.ConcreteClosureTest.EmitsConcreteClosures(name: \"DiscardedLoopBodies\", source: \"let a: i32 = 1\\nvar i: i32 = 0\\nwhile i < 2\\n    match i\\n        0 => i += 1\\n        _ => func [a] () => a\\n    i += 1\\nlet xs: [2 of i32] = [1, 2]\\nfor x in xs\\n    func [a, x] () => a + x\\n    func [x] () => x\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(i)\\\")\", output: \"2\\n\")

XunitTest.ConcreteClosureTest.EmitsConcreteClosures(name: \"DiscardedScalarArm\", source: \"let a: i32 = 1\\nlet i: i32 = 0\\nmatch i\\n    0 => func [a] () => a\\n    _ => ()\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(i)\\\")\", output: \"0\\n\")

XunitTest.ConcreteClosureTest.EmitsConcreteClosures(name: \"DiscardedWideArm\", source: \"let a: i64 = 1\\nlet b: i64 = 2\\nlet i: i32 = 0\\nmatch i\\n    0 => func [a, b] () => a + b\\n    _ => ()\\nConsole.writeLine(\\\"\\\\(i)\\\")\", output: \"0\\n\")
